prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original game HUD skill icon, square 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG with real transparent background.
Reference image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE BOARD ONLY: use the flat, few-colour illustrated visual language of its Black Flow forest node icons. It is not an edit target and its labels, arrangements, original symbols, and source artwork must NOT be copied.
Design a single memorable, asymmetric two-dimensional silhouette. Use only a few deliberate opaque colour fields with selective soft edges. The subject should occupy about 55–65% of the canvas width so its identity survives at 64–80px HUD display. Behind the subject is one near-black, almost-round irregular support about 66% of canvas width: incomplete softly uneven perimeter, dark distinguishable from the subject, not a hard circular button and not an outlined badge. One small local light focus connects the lit part of the subject to a restrained nearby glow, fading through the support edge to genuine alpha zero. Keep generous transparent space outside. No background rectangle, no checkerboard, no other objects, no title, no letters, no numerals, no watermark.
Painting: flat graphic hand-painted concept illustration as on the reference board, carefully chosen positive and negative shapes, understated local grain only. No shiny 3D metal, bevel, folded triangular facets, photorealistic materials, weapon inventory render, stock SVG icon, all-around bright halo, full luminous ring, symmetric ornamental emblem, tiny engraving, particle shower, or extra light source. The support and light are subordinate to the readable core silhouette.

Skill: 刺击 / fixed. Core image: a single ivory-blue sharply tapering blade-like shard thrust diagonally from lower left into a narrow torn rift at upper right. The rift is an irregular two-lipped dark opening shaped by the impact, not a second weapon or emblem. Distinguish the long, clean tapered thrust and the small split at its tip. Use muted cold bone, deep blue-grey and near-black; a concentrated pale turquoise flash only where the tip parts the opening. No handle, crossguard, conventional small sword, crossed weapons, circle of sparks or multiple spikes. The silhouette must read as one directed piercing action.
Structural revision: Reference image 2 is the first attempt to REPLACE, not an accepted final. Redesign it more compactly: the entire piercing subject stays within the central 60% of the square and the almost-round near-black support within the central 60–64%. Leave roughly 16% genuinely transparent canvas margin on all four edges. Replace the sprawling flame-like blade plume with a shorter solid tapering blade shard, a clean open negative slit at its tip, and just one subordinate split lip. The primary bright shape must be narrow and simple rather than a broad textured flame or giant corner-to-corner slash. Make the near-black support darker and less blue; keep the luminous area local at the upper-right piercing point. The complete icon must read as one compact illustrated object at small size, with no micro-cracks, shredded wisps or extended dark rift at the canvas edges. Use the reference board's concentrated silhouettes and sparse marks.
